rules.requirement: Each night*, choose 2 players: they die. A dead player you chose last night might be regurgitated.

assertingTests.name: a game whose older ruleset brought a player back on the Tinker's step refuses that now, and undo replays its journal (BMR-PROFESSOR-01, BMR-SHABALOTH-01)
a Lunatic shown the Shabaloth brings no one back on their step (BMR-SHABALOTH-01)
a multi-target night step rejects the same player twice (BMR-INNKEEPER-01, BMR-SHABALOTH-01, BMR-PO-01)
a Shabaloth blocked after prior choices still regurgitates last night's target (BMR-EXORCIST-01, BMR-SHABALOTH-01)
the Shabaloth kills two players and can regurgitate a target from last night (BMR-SHABALOTH-01)
the Shabaloth records its two players with last night's, and a poisoned or Goon-drunk Shabaloth records nothing (BMR-SHABALOTH-01, BMR-GOON-01)
a journal recorded while any night step resurrected replays and undoes as written (BMR-PROFESSOR-01, BMR-SHABALOTH-01)
a night step whose ability does not resurrect brings no one back (BMR-PROFESSOR-01, BMR-SHABALOTH-01)
a healthy Shabaloth records its two players, in the host's order (BMR-SHABALOTH-01)
